package repository

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"time"
)

type HybridApplications interface {
	ClaimHybridApplication(context.Context, time.Time, time.Duration) (domain.HybridApplicationWork, bool, error)
	CompleteHybridApplication(context.Context, domain.HybridApplicationWork, domain.HybridApplicationReceipt) error
	ReleaseHybridApplication(context.Context, domain.HybridApplicationWork, time.Time) error
	RecordHybridApplicationStale(context.Context, domain.HybridApplicationWork, string, time.Time) error
}
